title: After the Report
description:
Two months since you reported the internal misconduct to the company.
Today HR called.
"I'm calling to let you know the outcome."

choices.result_text:
The person received a disciplinary action.
'Thank you for reporting it,' they said.
Being recognized for doing the right thing — wasn't always how it went.
This time it was.

You confirmed the outcome.
Something had changed.
Reporting had been the right call — confirmed.

title: Staying Clean
description:
Three months since you held the line against temptation.
Today you looked back at whether that was right.
Word came that the path you'd been tempted toward had run into trouble.

choices.text: It was right to hold it
choices.result_text:
Holding out had been right.
Staying clean isn't losing an opportunity — it's waiting for a better one.
Now you understood the difference.

Partly luck.
But that luck only became luck because you'd held the line.
Choice creates luck.

title: The Price of Crossing the Line
description:
Two months since you crossed a line.
At the time you told yourself it was unavoidable.
Today that choice came back.

choices.result_text:
You tried to contain it.
Couldn't fully undo it.
Crossing a line once — the repair cost is higher than what you gained.
You learned that now.

choices.text: Admit it and try to correct it
choices.result_text:
You admitted it.
The other party said 'Better that you told me directly.'
Admitting the compromise — was the way to stop a second one.

title: After the Formal Complaint
description:
Two months since you filed the formal complaint.
Today the agency sent a resolution notice.

choices.result_text:
[Resolved]
The outcome arrived.
The formal process took time — but it worked.
Going by the book looks slow — but it doesn't collapse.

title: Becoming a Regular
description:
Three months of being a regular at the poker pub.
Today an unknown number called.
"Are you the person who comes to the OO poker pub regularly?"

choices.result_text:
An invitation to a tournament.
Becoming a regular had opened a new door.
Going often had quietly become a network.

choices.text: "How did you get my number?" — cautious
choices.result_text:
You were wary.
They said 'The pub owner gave it.'
Being cautious wasn't wrong.
Checking was the better move.

title: After Making the Rule
description:
Two months since you made a rule not to touch poker.
Today you walked past the poker pub.
For a moment, you felt like going in.

choices.result_text:
You kept walking.
Without the rule — you'd have gone in.
A rule is for keeping when the urge hits.
You kept it.

You went in.
Two hours passed.
The rule broke.
You'd need a stronger reason next time.

title: Knowing the Limit
description:
A month since you knew your limit at poker and stopped there.
Today someone you'd played with called.
"You stopped back then. That takes something."

choices.text: "Not really. I just had a rule."
choices.result_text:
'I just had a line I'd set,' you said.
They replied 'That's exactly what takes something.'
Having a rule — was the rarest thing at a poker table.

choices.text: "Did I? I just wasn't lucky that day."
choices.result_text:
'Just wasn't my lucky day,' you said.
They said '...That's actually scarier to hear.'
Calling it luck — creates the illusion luck will come next time.

title: After Winning 5th Place
description:
A month since the lotto 5th prize win.
5,000 won in winnings.
Today you bought another ticket.

choices.text: Just one. Don't let it become a habit.
choices.result_text:
You bought one.
5,000 won brought 1,000 won profit.
One ticket was the standard.
A fifth-place win shouldn't lead to five more tickets.

choices.text: Maybe I should buy more this time
choices.result_text:
You bought five.
All blanks.
The 5th prize win — made you buy five more.
A small win building larger expectations — that's how gambling is designed.

title: After the Small Win
description:
Two months since the small lottery win.
You felt good at the time.
Today you tried to remember where that money went.

choices.result_text:
You'd saved it.
The number was still there.
Even small luck — stays differently depending on what you do with it.

choices.text: Can't remember. Must've spent it somewhere.
choices.result_text:
You couldn't remember.
You'd spent it somewhere.
The small win — had drifted away without leaving a trace.
Nothing remained.

title: After the Recognition
description:
Two months since you were commended for working the orthodox way.
Today someone brought it up in a team meeting.

choices.result_text:
You just said 'Thank you.'
Someone said 'Honestly — that's the hardest part.'
The orthodox path — looks ordinary but staying on it is the hard part.

choices.text: Say it was just doing the job
choices.result_text:
'I was just doing the work,' you said.
They smiled.
Being unfazed about it — was itself an impression.

title: The Mentor
description:
Two months since you first met the CEO who'd once thrived and then gone bankrupt.
You kept in touch after.
Today they reached out first.
"How are things? Talk to me if you have something on your mind."

choices.text: Open up about what's been on your mind
choices.result_text:
You talked for an hour.
They said 'If I'd made that choice back then — things would have been different.'
The weight in a failed person's words — different from the advice of someone who only succeeded.

'Doing well,' you said.
They replied 'Good to hear.'
Leaving things unsaid at a table where you could have said them — you'd feel that later.

title: The Founder Mindset in Action
description:
Three months since you decided to think like a founder.
Today in a meeting — that way of thinking surfaced.

choices.text: Make the suggestion from that angle
choices.result_text:
You made the suggestion.
The team lead said 'Where did that come from?'
Thinking like a founder — showed up at the conference table.
Thought creates action.

You listened quietly.
A point you'd have missed before was visible now.
Even without speaking — what you saw had changed.

title: Trying to Get Out
description:
Two months since you tried to step back from the relationship.
It wasn't easy.
Today you tallied up where things stand.

choices.result_text:
You got out.
Something heavy became lighter.
Leaving a relationship isn't always running away.
This time — it wasn't.

You didn't fully leave.
There were reasons.
Having reasons for something and it being good — those aren't the same.

title: Joining the Group
description:
Two months since you joined the victim group.
Today you received an update on the class action progress.

choices.result_text:
The suit was moving forward.
Alone, you'd have given up.
People who've been through the same thing together — that creates something you don't have alone.

choices.text: It takes a lot of energy. Pull back a little.
choices.result_text:
You pulled back.
You were starting to drain.
Joining was right — but protecting yourself while staying was also a way to be there.

title: The Cost of the Underground Network
description:
Two months since you joined the unofficial network.
Today a request came from inside it.
It wasn't a structure you could easily walk away from.

choices.result_text:
You refused.
Getting out wasn't easy.
What it cost to leave — you only learned when you tried to leave.
Going in had been expensive.

You did it.
It wasn't just once.
'Just once' doesn't apply in this world.
